purpose: Compile a deterministic read-only view of active roots/surfaces, opportunity lifecycle, workers, returns, blockers, stale risk and useful free worker slots from durable evidence.

may: surface inconsistencies and stale time gates
must_not: create Current, Human Accepted or Served authority
declare dependency satisfaction that is not already evidenced
declare recovery eligible from elapsed time alone
mutate claims, runs, returns or owner state

projection_semantics.READY_UNCLAIMED: Opportunity is explicitly READY in an active queue and no claim is observed.
projection_semantics.CLAIMED_NOT_STARTED: Claim exists but no durable run/STARTED evidence is observed.
projection_semantics.WORKING: Latest run is in an active execution state and its own run has no durable return.
projection_semantics.RETURNED_NOT_TERMINAL: Return exists for the current run but the run is not terminal.
projection_semantics.DONE: Latest run is terminal DONE and evidence remains separately visible.
projection_semantics.BLOCKED_DEPENDENCY: Queue explicitly declares dependency blocking; priority never bypasses it.
projection_semantics.STALE_SUSPECT: Latest durable run signal is at least the configured suspect threshold old.
projection_semantics.RECOVERY_TIME_GATE_MET: Configured recovery time threshold is met, but retry safety/authority/current-target/collision proof is still required.
projection_semantics.RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED: A durable return exists for another attempt while a different run is current; neither attempt is discarded by recency.

capacity_rule: useful_free_slots counts only explicit READY_UNCLAIMED opportunities. BLOCKED_DEPENDENCY does not become capacity until a verified readiness source has made it READY.
clock_rule: The compiler receives one explicit now/cutoff. Same durable inputs plus the same cutoff must produce the same logical projection.

consumer_contract.live: May consume summary counts, blockers, stale risk and useful_free_slots as ambient telemetry only.
consumer_contract.universal_worker: May use the projection to choose where to inspect/assist next, but must still acquire the opportunity's own valid claim before substantive work.
consumer_contract.steward: May use reconciliation flags as routing evidence, never as an automatic disposition.

promotion_boundary: Implementation and canary evidence are candidate capability evidence only. Wiring into Live, allocator or production /w requires the owning integration/verification gates.
